Battery.description:
Battery state and the limits the dashboard's SOC grid needs.

Every energy value is in Wh and may be null while the inverter has not
been read yet - null means unknown, never zero.

`trace`, `decisive` and `event` are passed through from the decision
journal. Their inner shape is documented in

info.description:
Read-only access to a running batcontrol instance: control state, battery,
price/solar/consumption forecasts and the decision trace that explains why
batcontrol chose the current inverter mode.

**This API never changes anything.** Every endpoint is a GET. Runtime
overrides stay on the MQTT API.

Conventions:

* Timestamps are epoch **milliseconds** (the MQTT API uses seconds).
* Energy is **Wh per forecast slot**; energy series also carry `power_w`, the
  average power over the slot. At 15-minute resolution those differ by a
  factor of four.
* Prices are EUR/kWh with 4 decimals.
* Forecast slot 0 is the interval containing the current time. Slots that
  have passed since the last control cycle are not returned.
info.summary: Read-only API of a running batcontrol instance
info.title: batcontrol

Convenience endpoint for dashboards: the current price is always populated, independent of which decision path ran. Returns 503 until the first control cycle has completed.

get.description: Answers even before the first control cycle has completed, so it is usable as a container health check. This is the only endpoint that stays reachable without a token when api.auth_token is configured.

The values the inverter reported in the last control cycle, cached by the inverter itself - reading this endpoint never queries the inverter. Returns 404 for an unknown id and 503 before the first read.
The inverters batcontrol controls. With several inverters the other endpoints report them as one battery; use the ids here with /inverter/{inverter_id} for a single one.

Whether peak shaving ran in the last cycle, whether evcc suspended it, the resulting PV charge limit and the outcome of its rules. The parameters are in /config. Returns 503 until the logic has run once.

Current price with its rank, cheapest and most expensive slot, average and spread over the next 24 hours, per slot at the configured resolution. The window is independent of the optimizer horizon and cut short where the forecast ends (complete=false). Returns 503 until the first control cycle has completed.
